questions.question: Identify the institution referred to as reorganized in 1823: the preceding paragraph concerns the Main Pedagogical Institute reopened in 1829, while the following history concerns the gymnasium. Agree both editions after checking institutional history.

localizations.source: Identify the institution referred to as reorganized in 1823: the preceding paragraph concerns the Main Pedagogical Institute reopened in 1829, while the following history concerns the gymnasium. Agree both editions after checking institutional history.
localizations.ru: Уточнить, какое учреждение имеется в виду в абзаце «С преобразованием его в 1823 году»: предыдущий абзац относится к возобновлённому в 1829 году Главному педагогическому институту, тогда как далее речь о гимназии. Согласовать RU/EN после проверки истории учреждений.

questions.resolution: The St Petersburg Central State Historical Archive confirms that the Teacher Training Institute was combined with a gymnasium in 1823 and that the name Third St Petersburg Gymnasium was adopted in 1830.

questions.question: Verify the scope of the priority claim for Busse’s model curriculum: the article calls it the first model mathematics curriculum. Clarify whether this means the first common curriculum for all Russian gymnasiums.

localizations.source: Verify the scope of the priority claim for Busse’s model curriculum: the article calls it the first model mathematics curriculum. Clarify whether this means the first common curriculum for all Russian gymnasiums.
localizations.ru: Проверить рамки приоритета первой примерной программы Буссе: в статье она названа первой примерной программой по математике. Уточнить, имеется ли в виду первая общая программа для всех российских гимназий.

questions.resolution: The absolute priority claim was removed: both editions now say that Busse drew up a model mathematics curriculum, without calling it the first.
